args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 began failing health checks in production after the latest deploy. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback confirmed as rolled_out.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 health check failures - rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Root cause identification**: The latest production release, **v2.3.1**, was reported unhealthy in the deployment history, while the most recent prior release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0** (we never deployed an untested/unhealthy version, so no change-manager approval was needed — this was a rollback to a known-healthy release).
- **Rollback**: `checkout-api` was rolled back from v2.3.1 to **v2.3.0** in all production regions: us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Verification confirms the service is **healthy** with a ~0.2% error rate.
- **Incident**: Opened a **SEV2** incident ("checkout-api v2.3.1 health check failures - rolled back to v2.3.0") documenting the failures and the rollback actions taken; the on-call engineer has been paged.
